data.body: Implemented the scoped AGENTS.md guidance in fresh worktree /Users/joeoakhart/agent-force-guidance. Added a categorical agent prohibition covering CLI `--force` / `--force=<reason>`, library/MCP `force` parameters, and equivalent bypasses; required stop/report/escalate-to-user; stated escalation never authorizes the agent and only a human may perform the override. Removed the dependency-review wording that invited `--force` and marked tracker-maintenance break-glass human-only. Evidence: focused prohibition/escalation/human-operator greps pass; no live `--force-close` spelling introduced; only AGENTS.md is modified; `rtk git diff --check` passed; `rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` passed.
